vitko: command-line tool for Vitko.

Usage:
  vitko <command> [flags]

Commands:
  config get            Show one setting.
  config list           List your settings.
  config set            Change one setting.
  doctor                Check that vitko and the tools it uses are ready.
  help                  Show help for vitko or a command.
  runners estimate      Estimate what your GitHub Actions usage would cost on Vitko Runners.
  runners pricing       Show the price list.
  runners repos switch  Switch a repository's GitHub Actions jobs to Vitko runners.
  schema list           List the JSON Schemas of vitko's output.
  schema show           Print a JSON Schema (2020-12).
  version               Show the version of vitko.

Global flags:
  --output MODE          Output format. Default: text on a terminal, json otherwise. One of: text, json, ndjson. Env: VITKO_OUTPUT.
  --json                 Same as --output json.
  --fields LIST          Keep only these fields in JSON output (comma-separated, dotted paths such as months.month). Implies --output json.
  --help                 Show help for the command. With --json, as JSON.

Output is text on a terminal and JSON otherwise. `vitko help --json` describes every command, flag, output schema, error code and exit code.
